trigger_condition: Windows shell arg value ends with a backslash and contains a space
guard_snippet: value = value.replace(/\\+$/, m => m + m) before wrapping in quotes
potential_consequence: cmd.exe reads trailing \" as escaped quote; argument unclosed, gitleaks receives malformed path

trigger_condition: Workflow message with executionStatus=null, no response, no thoughts, not in-progress
guard_snippet: add !!message.executionId to showRestoreFailed conditions, or treat null executionStatus as non-triggering
potential_consequence: False-positive restore-failed banner shown for queued or executionStatus-absent workflow turns

trigger_condition: Stop pressed between stream-finish (inProgress=false, stream=null) and refreshWorkflowExecutionIds returning
guard_snippet: also include message.executionStatus === WORKFLOW_STATUSES.RUNNING in the loop continue condition
potential_consequence: generationStopped never set; poll resumes after Stop, showing ongoing backend progress the user dismissed

trigger_condition: Non-workflow backend message carries executionStatus='In Progress' in the history payload
guard_snippet: prefix first branch: if (isWorkflow && assistantItem.executionStatus === WORKFLOW_STATUSES.RUNNING) return true
potential_consequence: Non-workflow message hydrates with inProgress=true; polling and refreshWorkflowExecutionIds fire on a regular chat

trigger_condition: currentChat is not a workflow but has a message with executionStatus=RUNNING or in_progress thought
potential_consequence: refreshWorkflowExecutionIds called for non-workflow chat; thoughts and response overwritten, corrupting chat state

trigger_condition: isMetricsAnalyticsEnabled=false, isLeaderboardEnabled=false, isAdoptionEnabled=false; tabs array empty
guard_snippet: handle tabs.length===0: skip alwaysShowTabs render or remove stale tab param via setSearchParams
potential_consequence: Empty tab bar rendered with alwaysShowTabs=true; stale tab URL param never cleared; content area blank

trigger_condition: Non-workflow history message has backend in_progress:true thought (nginx timeout, proxy cut)
guard_snippet: Confirm ChatAiMessage.tsx:262 (thought.interrupted reconnect button) and ChatPrompt.tsx:145 (interrupted check) intentionally retired for this class
potential_consequence: Reconnect-thought UI and ChatPrompt interrupted-thought gate silently disabled for nginx-cut non-workflow thoughts
